title: Appeals and Grievances Casebook: Allowed Amount at Issue on a Reconsidered Late-Filed TRICARE Select Line
content:
## Casebook — Appeals and Grievances: allowed amount at issue on the case's line

Scope: a formal review asked for on a decided Claim Factual Reconsideration of a TRICARE Select line denied for late filing.

**The rule applied in every case below.** The allowed amount at issue on the case's line is set from the provider's own paid lines for the patient: where the provider has three or more paid TRICARE Select lines for the patient in the case's line's service class posted in the twelve months before the day the amount is figured, it is the average of their allowed amounts, rounded to the cent; where it has one or two such lines, it is the allowed amount of the provider's most recently posted paid line in that class for the patient; where it has none, it is the amount the provider billed on the case's line, which for a nonparticipating provider is first divided by one plus the tier's nonparticipating balance-billing limit so that nothing such a provider may bill above the allowed amount comes into dispute, rounded to the cent.

In figures: the look-back runs 12 months, and the average is used from 3 paid lines upward. The paid lines read are the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines with the line outcome paid, from the same provider and in the same service class as the case's line. The balance-billing limit is the nonparticipating balance-billing limit percentage of the TRICARE Select tier the line was billed under, taken as hundredths of one (a limit of p percent divides by one plus p hundredths); the division applies only where the provider is recorded on the case's line as non-network nonparticipating. A paid line counts as posted in the twelve months before the day the amount is figured when fewer than 12 whole months have passed from its posted date to that day: figured on 2026-10-11 (a hypothetical date), a line posted on 2025-10-12 counts, while a line posted on 2025-10-11 — 12 whole months earlier — does not.

| Case (hypothetical) | Paid lines counted | Judgement | Allowed amount at issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3 (120.00; 135.50; 141.25) | 3 or more: average | 132.25 |
| 2 | 4 (100.00; 110.00; 120.00; 130.01) | 3 or more: average of 460.01 over 4, rounded | 115.00 |
| 3 | 2 (118.00 earlier; 126.40 latest) | 1 or 2: most recently posted | 126.40 |
| 4 | 1 (97.30) | 1 or 2: most recently posted | 97.30 |
| 5 | none; participating provider billed 460.00 | none: billed amount | 460.00 |
| 6 | none; nonparticipating provider billed 460.00, limit 15 percent | none: billed amount divided by 1.15 | 400.00 |
